blocking: Desktop descend section (index-desktop-1): the trunks-tall art crosses the centre column — a pomegranate and leaves sit directly behind the statement sub-line 'Anar Events plans and runs weddings…'. That breaks the 'edges and bottom only, middle open' rule on the one section after the hero that should prove it.

Phone (index-phone-1, index-phone-3): two fixed pills ('Pause motion' bottom-left, 'How we work +' bottom-right) cover live content — the Sofreh Aghd heading and its Persian line, and the Mehndi / Sangeet stop. On a 390px screen they eat ~70px of every viewport and collide with the brand's own type.

fixes.what: At min-width 1024px set width:150vw (or add a centre mask: mask-image:linear-gradient(to right,#000 22%,transparent 38%,transparent 62%,#000 78%)) so no branch or fruit sits behind the 880px text column.
fixes.why: Hard rule: tree frames edges and bottom, the middle stays open — desktop-1 shows fruit behind the statement.

fixes.what: On ≤768px make it the same slim vertical edge tab as desktop (right:0; top:50%; writing-mode:vertical-rl; padding:14px 8px; font-size:13px) instead of a full pill in the bottom-right corner.
fixes.why: Phone-1/phone-3: the pill covers 'سفرهٔ عقد' and 'Mehndi / Sangeet'; an edge tab never sits on content and matches the white-desert reference the owner chose.

fixes.what: On phones hide the toggle once the hero has scrolled out (add .is-hidden via the existing IntersectionObserver pattern, or move it into the header drawer); on desktop reduce to a 36px icon-only round button with aria-label.
fixes.why: A utilitarian control pinned on every screen reads as a dev tool, not a luxury studio; on phone-1 it overlaps the Sofreh Aghd h3.

fixes.what: Replace the loop: the current footage shows St Peter's dome, Rome. Use a loop with no recognisable foreign landmark (garden/tent/golden-hour Bay Area or anonymous estate), or re-crop the frame below the skyline.
fixes.why: A Bay Area Persian studio opening on the Vatican skyline is a tell that undercuts the 'real, not costume' promise.

fixes.what: Give the tab a solid var(--night) fill (drop the .7 alpha) so it stays a night-palette object over parchment, or toggle a class when an .on-light section is in view that swaps to parchment fill + ruby border.
fixes.why: Over the parchment quote the translucent fill renders as a muddy grey smudge beside ruby type.

fixes.what: Set grid-template-columns:repeat(9,minmax(0,1fr)); .journey__en{font-size:15px;text-wrap:balance}; shorten the English to 'Bale-boroon' and put 'Shirini-khori' in the note.
fixes.why: Desktop-3: that one label wraps to three lines and the nine stops lose their shared baseline on the 'one line' device.
